content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-25. - Proof of mailing of notice.
content.summary:
Proof of mailing of notice shall be by affidavit of the engineer, clerk or any deputy
               mailing the notice.
(Code 1981, § 27-26; Ord. No. 551, § 13(D), 5-14-1964)
